description: This file defines the MenuItemAPI class, which is part of the OrangeHRM mobile API module. It provides an endpoint to list available menu items based on user roles, modules' status, and configuration settings. The class handles permissions, retrieves module status, and dynamically constructs menu structures for mobile clients.

classes.description: Defines a REST API endpoint for retrieving mobile menu items based on user role, module status, and configuration.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles the GET request to list available menu items for the mobile app, factoring in user role, module status, and configuration settings.
